== Course of events ==

The encounter between Jack Pumpkinhead and The Scarecrow had earlier been clouded by confusion, as Jellia Jamb's mischievous mistranslations made each seem to insult the other. Once Jack Pumpkinhead and The Scarecrow discover that only one language is spoken throughout Oz, the misunderstanding dissolves. With no true insult between them, The Scarecrow declares that he and Jack Pumpkinhead are friends.

Having settled the matter, The Scarecrow leads Jack Pumpkinhead off to play quoits, the two now on easy terms with one another.
